name: scitadel
description: Scitadel — local-first literature management with an MCP server for annotating papers and exposing your reading to an adjacent agent.

plugins.name: scitadel
plugins.description: Registers the scitadel MCP server (stdio). On first launch it fetches the pinned scitadel release binary for your platform from GitHub Releases, verifies its checksum, caches it, and runs `scitadel mcp`. No manual PATH setup.
